decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits close to the core pipeline offer and was upgraded to its own page, so it costs little to keep and remains a valuable option tied to the firm's established water-infrastructure customers.

The powder-coated public waste bin is distant from the core business, but it uses the existing coating and fabrication equipment and serves municipal customers, so keeping the option open costs little while demand is still uncertain.

The waste bin with ashtray is a low-cost variant of the bin line built on existing powder-coating capability, so management keeps it until results show more clearly whether the street-furniture diversification pays off.

Outdoor ashtrays are a niche, distant product with uncertain value, but holding them in the coated street-furniture range costs little, so the option stays open rather than being abandoned prematurely.
